# Synthetic Anthropic stream-part cases

Every input in `cases.json` is synthetic: it was written for this suite, is not a
recorded or upstream fixture, and makes no claim about what the live Anthropic API
sends. `expected-parts.jsonl` is generated by running the registered upstream
`@ai-sdk/anthropic` `doStream` over each input, so the upstream package is the
oracle for provider parts. Regenerate with `mise run generate-conformance`.

The Go comparison explicitly adjusts final input-cache totals for
`usage-resets-and-metadata-carries-across-messages`,
`delta-less-message-repeats-iterations-and-context-management`, and
`null-context-management-delta-keeps-previous` to assert the registered
`anthropic-executor-iteration-cache-usage` deviation. It first verifies the
upstream totals, then expects 4 cache-read and 2 cache-write tokens from the
retained executor iteration, for 16 total input tokens. All other parts and
fields remain compared with the unchanged upstream-generated snapshot.
